stem: Monumental changes taking place in the structures of world business match some equally ____ changes taking place in the relations of international companies to the governments with which they deal.

The idea of traveling in order to find natural extremes and wonders was (i) ____ in eighteenth- and nineteenth-century Europe, and many European travelers of the period were drawn to Iceland and other North Atlantic countries as places where they might find these (ii) ____ landscapes.

Until recently superhero comics were seen as irredeemably (i)____ ; they were widely disparaged for being so (ii)____ in conception and execution, and anyone who was a fan was given plenty of reasons to be (iii)____.
His lackadaisical approach to this project belies his well-known reputation for ____.

The most interesting discoveries in astronomy are often the things researchers could never have anticipated; new instruments enable scientists to make such ____ discoveries, which can then take years to understand.
The simplicity of Ann Hamilton’s sculpture, a single drop of water snaking its way down a vast white wall, ____ the elaborate technical apparatus hidden beneath its surface.

Critics of compost production often do not fully consider the potential environmental benefits of compost use—benefits that might ____ the energy consumption, gaseous emissions, and other negative environmental effects attributable to compost production.
